def mv(pose, tag):
    r = primitives.call(name='move_rlbench_arm_to', target_pose=list(pose), strategy='rlbench_pose_action')
    o = r.output
    gp = None
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        for k in ['gripper_pose', 'state_fields', 'observation_summary']:
            if k in o:
                gp = o[k]
                break
    print(tag, r.ok, str(o)[:200] if not r.ok else 'ok')
    return r

def gp(tn):
    g = primitives.call(name='ground_rlbench_target', target_name=tn)
    o = g.output if g.ok else None
    pe = o.get('pose_evidence') if isinstance(o, dict) else None
    return pe.get('pose_world') if isinstance(pe, dict) else None
